registration: task list selected once at episode start; independent persistent scores

selection.candidates: registered operation objects whose actual footprint intersects robot sector
selection.front_metric: absolute heading error from robot forward direction to operation object target

timeout.progress: net sum of all registered task scores increases between valid score observations

requested_physics_hz: selected task approved rate; 60 when none selected
